name: Grace Madison
source:
The pressure of competing against the Ultimate Golfer leaves many of her opponents afraid of ever meeting her face-to-face on the green. Grace wants the world to know that she will continue to crush any challenger that tries to claim her title, relentlessly defending her Ultimate status. Those who've once friended this firecracker athlete eventually walk away broken and scarred by their interactions with her, questioning if she is willing to burn every bridge on her way to the top.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1357793295766859776]official description[/url]]
